name: Clothach

attributes.attribute: carries the Irish meaning famous or renowned
name also borne by a Christian saint with a 3 May feast day

text: Clothach stands in Irish legend as a grandson of the Dagda, the good god. His descent places him inside the divine family that fills the oldest tales of Ireland. The name itself is Irish and means famous or renowned. It signals high standing for anyone who bore it in early tradition. A separate Christian saint also carries this name, and her feast day falls on 3 May. The shared name links pagan legend with the calendar of the Irish church.

okr.objective: Clothach is a legendary grandson of the Dagda whose name also belongs to a Christian saint.
key_results: The Irish name Clothach means famous or renowned.
Clothach is a grandson of the Dagda.
A Christian saint with a 3 May feast day also bears this name.
